_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows Jules reminder details and account state in a compact card.

description: Create a reminder directly on the connected Jules account.

callWindowMinutes.description: How many minutes before the scheduled time Jules should call.

recurrenceDays.description: Weekday numbers for custom recurrence, Sunday = 0 through Saturday = 6.

scheduledAt.description: The reminder time as an ISO datetime string. Only use this after the user has provided or confirmed an exact time.

snoozeRetries.description: How many retry calls Jules should make.

timeExpression.description: The user's original time wording, preserved exactly, such as '4:00 PM' or '16:00'. If the user said something fuzzy like 'later this afternoon', ask a follow-up instead of calling this tool.

name: create_jules_reminder
title: Create a Jules reminder
